Author: platis
Name: XIV.fm
Punchline: Share what you are listening to in Final Fantasy XIV.
Description: XIV.fm displays Last.fm listening presence on cards anchored above player nameplates.
Changelog: Adds independent 50–150% size controls for your listening card and other players’ cards. The Server Info Bar shortcut is now .FM, using the bar’s default yellow while cards are visible and red while hidden.
